0022600172.text: The Miami Heat (2-4) head into their seventh game of the season on a two-game winning streak, sitting 10th in the East and 1 game back in fifth place in the Southeast, with a 1-1 road record. The Los Angeles Lakers (4-2) are first in the Pacific and 7th in the West, and they have lost their most recent game. Adou Thiero (knee, inflammation) and Ziaire Williams (foot) are both out for Los Angeles, while the Heat have no players listed as unavailable.
